# DengYue Medicine

> > HK DengYue Medicine: Pharmaceutical distribution and oncology solutions connecting China's pharmaceutical market with global healthcare standards.

DengYue Medicine specializes in pharmaceutical distribution, oncology disease management, and connecting international buyers with China's pharmaceutical manufacturing ecosystem. The company focuses on regulatory compliance (FDA, EMA, NMPA), quality assurance through GDP standards, and emerging therapeutic areas including HIV treatment and cancer care.

## Key Topics

- DengYue Medicine
- China pharmaceutical market
- Oncology diseases and cancer treatment
- HIV treatment (Biktarvy)
- Pharmaceutical distribution and supply chain
- Regulatory compliance (FDA, EMA, NMPA)
- GDP standards
- Drug innovation and manufacturing
- Clinical trials
- Active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs)
- Bictegravir, emtricitabine, tenofovir alafenamide (TAF)
- Global pharmaceutical market access
- Artificial intelligence in pharma
- Genomics
